I find the top frustrating and somewhat dissatisfying, but I also am proud of the design, the work, and the knowledge that I put into creating it.  it’s not wrong to feel conflicted about your own work as an artist or creator. the end result may not always be proportional to the time or energy spent on making it. sometimes you just have to know when to let those frustrations go so they don’t overshadow your ability to appreciate and learn from your own creative process 🤍 #filetcrochet #crochet #thriftedyarn #handmadetop #artistsoftiktok
